conventions.axes: engine axes (-Xb, Zb, -Yb): x = -Blender X, y = Blender Z (up), z = -Blender Y. Same as the engine's Gltf loader (glTF (Xb, Zb, -Yb) with X flipped). Units: metres.
conventions.glbAxes: glb files are standard glTF (Xb, Zb, -Yb); load them with the normal Gltf loader and the walks.json numbers line up.
conventions.yawPitch: degrees, absolute. forward = (sin(yaw)cos(pitch), sin(pitch), -cos(yaw)cos(pitch)); up (roll 0) = (-sin(yaw)sin(pitch), cos(pitch), cos(yaw)sin(pitch)). forward/up are also given per scene camera.
conventions.keys: sampled at 30 Hz, interpolate linearly. Smooth path only: add bob/sway/hand from 'shake' on top.
conventions.transition: keys run in the 'from' scene starting at t=0 (first key = where the camera rests after the previous arrival). Fade to black over fade.start..fade.end (end = last key). Then switch to the 'to' scene and play arrive.keys with fade-in over arrive.fadeIn. The last arrive key is where the camera rests until the next transition.
conventions.fovY: vertical field of view in degrees for a 9:16 portrait view
conventions.mood: creep = slow cautious walk (small bob, stronger hand shake); chase = running (big bob/sway/roll, heavy motion blur, darker). transition.mood applies to keys; arrive.mood to arrive.keys. Pick shake.byMood[mood].
conventions.sounds: t in seconds from the start of its part ('out' = keys, 'arrive' = arrive.keys; with repeat, replay the arrive sounds on every repeat). Names are entries of project.json sounds; the same sound may overlap itself.

doc.bob: step phase ph: creep uses distance, ph = d/stepLen (d = 3D distance walked); chase uses time, ph += cadenceHz*dt*min(1, speed/0.3 m/s) (running cadence does not follow the short distance). vertical dip = -amp*k*(1-cos(2*pi*ph))/2 with k = min(1, speed/0.5 m/s) (chase: speed/0.3); pitch nod = -pitchDeg*k*sin(2*pi*ph). A footfall is where ph crosses an integer
doc.sway: sideways = amp*k*sin(pi*ph) along camera right; roll = rollDeg*k*sin(pi*ph)
doc.hand: always on (also while standing): sum_i sin(2*pi*f_i*t + phase_i + seed*1.7)/(1+i) / 2.08 * amp with phases [0,1.3,2.1,0.7]; seeds yaw 1, pitch 2, roll 3, pos x/y/z 4/5/6
doc.post: motionBlurShutter: fraction of a frame the shutter stays open (0.3 = light trails, 0.9 = heavy smear). darken: 0..1 extra darkness with a vignette while the mood lasts; hides stretched texture when running

start.note: stand still with hand shake only until the first transition

repeat.doc: play arrive.keys count times; blend each restart over crossfade seconds (a short dip to black works too)
